en: Raka and his grandmother planted beans in a small garden. Every day they looked for green shoots, but the soil stayed dry.
One afternoon, dark clouds came. Big drops fell on the roof, tap, tap, tap. Raka ran to the window and smiled.
The next morning, tiny green leaves poked out of the wet soil. “The rain gave our beans a drink,” said Grandmother.
id: Raka dan neneknya menanam kacang di kebun kecil. Setiap hari mereka mencari tunas hijau, tetapi tanahnya tetap kering.
Suatu sore, awan gelap datang. Tetes air besar jatuh di atap, tik, tik, tik. Raka berlari ke jendela dan tersenyum.
Keesokan paginya, daun hijau kecil muncul dari tanah yang basah. “Hujan memberi minum kacang kita,” kata Nenek.

prompt.en: What did Raka and his grandmother plant?
prompt.id: Apa yang ditanam Raka dan neneknya?

prompt.en: Why did Raka smile at the window?

en: He knew rain would help the beans.
He wanted to go outside to play.
id: Ia tahu hujan akan membantu kacangnya.
